threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still say 'going to the Tube' like it’s a quick jaunt, not a whole day’s saga of delays and packed carriages.
Last night on the 47, the driver was blasting 90s garage. Half the bus was vibing, the other half scowling. Classic South London night out.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw the old lady in the window feeding pigeons while deafening techno blasted from the street below. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a hidden Kiez-Kneipe that doubles as an art gallery and hosts poetry slams every Tuesday. It's like a cultural time capsule!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by their tolerance for BART delays—only a true San Franciscan knows to pack snacks and a book for the commute.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo catching the 6 while holding a bouquet. I guess even Muni can't ruin a wedding vibe for everyone.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists flock to Parc Güell, but a quiet corner of Plaça del Sol has sunsets that locals keep to themselves. It's a whole different vibe.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by their reluctance to use the escalators at Diagonal; they insist on walking to be 'local' but don’t realize it's a workout.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the weekend's meant for sleeping in. Locals have their best nights out on a Monday at The Alibi.
Last night the N35 was packed with party-goers, but the lad in the corner was just muttering about his cat's diet. Strange what unfolds at 2 AM.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The night I heard an impromptu reggae jam on the street, while someone sold homemade samosas out of their kitchen window. That's Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a late-night kebab shop where the owner critiques your life choices while grilling your meat. It’s a whole vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a true local knows to avoid the BART Civic Center station when the fog rolls in—smoke and chaos are just part of the commute.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus today with a busker belting out tunes. Half the riders were humming along, transforming the usual grind into a makeshift concert.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all the bars close early, but if you wander a bit past 2 AM, you’ll find hidden gems still buzzing with life.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them by their struggle to pronounce 'Gràcia' correctly while still fumbling with the metro card at Liceu station.
